ShortDescription.Value: Fix Not Enough Customers icons by balancing commercial shop production and shopping demand.

Publish.LongDescription:
# 🛒 Too many "Not Enough Customers" icons?
**满城都是“顾客不足”警告**
**Adding more citizens doesn't always fix it!**
This mod helps struggling shops recover by balancing production and shopping. No fake shoppers, no complicated settings!
### Why does vanilla struggle?
* **90%+ unused Service** is exactly what triggers NEC Icons. But vanilla's shopping-priority score doesn't separate struggling shops of unused Service from 50% - 100%, a big basket that doesn't prioritize the 89% - 100% shops. * Shop workers get paid to produce Service. Service is different from goods (e.g., food, paper...) delivered. * **Shops keep producing** even when they already have too much unsold Service. Vanilla doesn't clamp production to zero until the shop hits 100% full Service which is too late to prevent the NEC icons. * Citizens can't shop while at work or school. Only available adults and elderly can handle normal shopping, making rush hours especially difficult.
**Result: Too much Service, and shoppers keep visiting healthy shops instead of desperate shops with NEC icons!**
### How this mod helps
* ✅ Shops slow production starting at 80% unsold Service, to prevent "Not Enough Customers" caused at critical 90%. * ✅ **Spreads out extra shopping**, helps prevent sudden waves of shoppers to reduce traffic. Uses existing citizens, no fake shoppers. * ✅ Helps Retail and Leisure businesses (Meals, Entertainment, Recreation). * ✅ Helps Hotels fill empty rooms using existing tourists.
### Real test results 🎉
* **130k city:** 165 NEC → just **4** after ~30 minutes. * **90k city:** 335 NEC → **30** after 10 minutes, **7** after 20 minutes
### What to expect
* **Install and play!** No Options menu settings needed. * Cities show reduction in 5 minutes. Allow **30+ minutes** for major changes. * After the city runs a bit, for the few 5-15 remaining, it's time to prune some or check pathing to those buildings. * Companion [mod City Watchdog](https://mods.paradoxplaza.com/mods/144908/Windows) recommended to easily see totals like shown in the screenshot. Make sure to put a "blue star" next to Not Enough Customers. * Safe to remove, goes back to vanilla. No Harmony patch means more compatible with other mods/the game. * This mod is a temp fix until IFS improves commercial balancing to stop the flood of "Not Enough Customers" Icons.
**Tips:** full commercial demand bar doesn't mean your citizens can support more shops! It means companies are looking for spaces which is optional to build.
**Other mods:** that increase commercial workers can make NEC warnings worse! More workers may produce Service faster than customers can use it.
### Support and Feedback
* Support by clicking the LIKE 👍 button (top right)! No donations, just a free like for the many days of work. * Feedback: [Discord](https://discord.gg/gwXgvtyhjc) | [GitHub](https://github.com/River-Mochi/CS2-NoCustomersFix), GPL-3.0 license.
### Credits and Thanks
* RiverMochi: mod author * Sunny Scunny: testing

**满城都是“顾客不足”警告？增加人口也不一定能解决！**
本模组通过减少商店过剩产出、合理调整购物需求，帮助商店恢复经营。
**不制造虚假顾客，安装即用，无需设置！**
### ✅ 主要功能
* **提前预防：** 商店闲置服务达到 **80%** 就开始减产，尽量避免达到 **90%** 时出现“顾客不足”警告。 * **减少购物拥堵：** 分散额外购物需求，避免顾客突然大量涌入，帮助缓解交通压力。 * **改善商业经营：** 帮助商店、餐饮、娱乐设施吸引更多顾客。 * **帮助酒店：** 利用现有游客，提高客房入住率。
### 🎉 实际测试效果
* **13万人城市：** 165 个警告 → 约30分钟后仅剩 **4 个！** * **9万人城市：** 335 个警告 → 10分钟后剩 **30 个**，20分钟后仅剩 **7 个！**
### 使用说明
* **安装即可生效！** 部分城市约5分钟就能看到改善，明显变化可能需要运行 **30分钟以上**。 * 如果仍有少量警告，可检查道路连接，或适当减少多余商店。 * **可安全卸载，不使用 Harmony 补丁。**
**💡 提示：** 商业需求条满了，不代表城市真的需要更多商店！
**喜欢这个模组？欢迎点个赞 👍！感谢支持！**
Publish.ChangeLog: * Reduced extra shopping traffic and improved performance. * Slow excess commercial Service production sooner: 80% preventive, 84% strong. * Shopping correction spread over time with lower limits. * Target 87% unused Service to reduce unneeded shopping trips.
